articles.title: TrumpRx, US government's cash-pay drug purchasing portal, primed for launch
articles.summary: On Thursday evening, President Donald Trump is set to debut TrumpRx, a government-run website that will direct patients toward cash-pay channels where they can purchase certain prescription drugs.

articles.title: Infinitus launches agentic AI support for health plans
articles.summary: The Agentic AI Member Services Suite personalizes communications with members and extends the bandwidth of health plan call centers.

articles.title: Him & Hers plans to offer cheaper version of Wegovy pill, prompting Novo Nordisk to threaten legal action
articles.summary: A month after drugmaker Novo Nordisk launched its Wegovy pill, online health and wellness company Hims & Hers plans to undercut it with a compounded semaglutide pill offered at a lower price.

articles.title: Cigna CEO Cordani says Express Scripts' new PBM model aligns with reforms, FTC settlement
articles.summary: Cigna's top brass said that the company has anticipated a "clearing event" in the pharmacy benefit management industry, and that its new model aligns with regulators' push toward greater transparency.

articles.title: CMS estimates 14.3M Medicare beneficiaries are enrolled in an ACO for 2026
articles.summary: The number of Medicare beneficiaries treated in accountable care organizations continues to rise, according to new data from the Trump administration.

articles.title: Epic's AI scribe goes live as EHR giant touts strong adoption of built-in AI features
articles.summary: Epic is rapidly building out artificial intelligence tools integrated into its EHR as health IT companies strive to keep up with the dizzying speed of AI innovation.

articles.title: IT to fuel hospital supply chain price inflation as pharmacy growth softens: Vizient
articles.summary: Hospitals’ supply chain teams should expect to see pharmacy price inflation temper from the third quarter of 2026 to the second quarter of 2027, but other indirect spending and purchased services to jump higher, according to a recent forecast report.

articles.title: FTC, Express Scripts reach settlement in insulin pricing case
articles.summary: Express Scripts and the Federal Trade Commission have officially reached a settlement in an ongoing case over insulin prices, with the PBM agreeing to a slew of business changes.

articles.title: California AG sues Rady Children's Health over halted gender-affirming care services
articles.summary: The decision, spurred by federal funding threats, runs afoul of a merger agreement to sustain specialty care services including gender-affirming care the pediatric system made in 2024, California Attorney General Rob Bonta said.

articles.title: Optum unveils 2 new AI-powered tools for digital prior authorization
articles.summary: Optum is rolling out new AI-powered tools that are aimed to reduce delays associated with prior authorization.

articles.title: Hims & Hers to sell Grail’s Galleri multi-cancer blood test via its digital health platform

articles.title: A closer look at Elevance Health’s AI strategy
articles.summary: This week on "Podnosis," we explore how Elevance Health is putting AI into practice while building ethical guardrails.

articles.title: Chamber gets a $60M jolt to power value-based care for cardiology practices
articles.summary: Chamber scored a $60 million series A funding round to build out its tech-enabled delivery platform that supports cardiologists in the transition to value-based care.

articles.title: Healthcare bankruptcies declined in 2025, though providers remain hard-pressed
articles.summary: Though Chapter 11 bankruptcy filings dropped by 21% from 2024 to 2025, increases in hospitals and senior care, plus looming headwinds, are still cause for caution, Gibbins Advisors warns.

articles.title: Kaiser Permanente, Renown Health launch northern Nevada joint venture
articles.summary: The nonprofits are building an outpatient care network of new and existing sites in northern Nevada while expanding Renown's existing health plan for value-based coverage, all under the Kaiser Permanente Nevada banner.

articles.title: Carbon Health files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy relief with more than $100M in debt
articles.summary: The company, which offers both in-person care at nearly 100 clinics and virtual care services, said Monday it reached a restructuring agreement with its existing lenders that establishes a "clear path to recapitalization and new ownership.

articles.title: SCAN adds 127K members in Medicare annual enrollment window

articles.title: HHS plans to invest $100M to support addiction recovery and address homelessness
articles.summary: The program will fund targeted outreach, psychiatric care, medical stabilization and crisis intervention for individuals experiencing homelessness and substance use disorder. The department's announcement framed the efforts as a sharp turn from “misguided” policies of the Biden administration, such as a reliance on harm reduction strategies.

articles.title: Community Health Systems closes $600M Tennessee hospital sale to VUMC
articles.summary: The for-profit hospital chain held 80% interests in two joint ventures running a 270-bed hospital and other ancillary businesses in Clarksville, Tennessee. The Vanderbilt University Medical Center said it plans to quickly staff up as it expands its regional hospital network to the growing city.
